document.name: NY Kids Club Cobble Hill Classes
document.shortDescription: Weekday enrichment classes in Cobble Hill for babies, toddlers, and young kids with music, art, STEM, and movement.
document.longDescription:
NY Kids Club Cobble Hill publishes an official Summer 2025 enrichment schedule for children from infancy through early elementary ages. The official materials describe classes for babies, toddlers, and older young children, with activity areas spanning music, art, science, movement, and school-readiness style enrichment.

The public Cobble Hill schedule and location materials show weekday programming with classes beginning in the morning and continuing through afternoon and after-school windows at the Cobble Hill center on Court Street. The current official location page search result lists the address as 299 Court St, Brooklyn, NY 11231 with phone 917-935-4850 and email cobblehill@nypreschoolandkidsclub.com.

Sources: https://nypreschoolandkidsclub.com/location/cobble-hill/ https://nypreschoolandkidsclub.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Cobble-Hill-Summer-2025-Class-Schedule.pdf https://dev.nykidsclub.com/wp-content/themes/nykids/images/nykidsclub_logo.jpg
